Messages.Author: Jana Wright
Messages.Body:
> What, no place in Israel? Suprising, since that's the place this whole new
> concept was set up to pacify.

1) Any overseas dates are to be set at a later time by the overseas WotC branches.
2) There was more to the name change than Israel: almost no one can pronounce Jyhad
properly, (it is not JYE-Had), they didn't know it had to do with vampires, and
a great many people thought that it was an insensitive promotion of terrorism.
Whether or not we agree, it was deemed appropriate to change the name.

> On a less bitter note, why so many baseball card stores? The few places listed
> in Indiana that I recognized wouldn't recognize a vampire if one walked up and
> bit them on the neck. They do have a display box or three of jyhad laying
> around, though.

Because distributors sell to them. Sports card shops recognize that the sport card
market is dropping, but there's this hot new TCG fad they can get in on. We sell
to distributors, they sell to whomever they like in whatever fashion they like.
